name: Fabric Mirroring
short_description: A managed Microsoft Fabric capability that continuously replicates external databases, or their metadata, into OneLake as Delta tables in near real time without building pipelines.

evidence.quote: That is the promise of fabric mirroring, and it is not the same thing as copying your data once. Welcome to the M365 FM
that will decide whether we need to have shortcut or mirroring or copying of data.
That copying is called mirroring, and it works continuously as you save rows.
Mirroring is a way to replicate your operational database into one lake continuously
Mirroring skips those chores so you don't schedule a nightly copy.
Microsoft calls mirroring a fully managed service
Continuity across systems enable mirroring and digital twin modeling.
